_note: Hand-curated. Roll ids are chosen by reading the Clerk's titles; the member's vote is pulled from data/votes.json, never typed here. statementRx matches titles; statementPicks adds specific releases with a verbatim snippet found by 'rx' in the release's full text (data/statements_full.json). No editorial verdicts except the Israel card's headline, set in 'israel.headline'.

issues.name: Cost of living and energy
issues.intro: His statements on gas, heating and utility costs, many tied to the Iran war.

statementPicks.t: Schumer said gas prices were at new highs for families and blamed Trump and congressional Republicans.
statementPicks.q: Gas prices just reached new highs and families are seeing no relief in sight, but Trump and Congressional Republicans don’t seem to care about the pain American families are feeling at the pump,”

issues.name: Health care
issues.intro: His statements on health care costs and coverage.

statementPicks.t: Schumer said that without action to extend the ACA tax credits, 4 million people are estimated to become uninsured.
statementPicks.q: In addition, if Republicans in Congress take no action to extend the ACA tax credits, 4 million people are estimated to become uninsured.

issues.name: Government funding
issues.intro: Votes on funding bills and his statements on them.

items.t: {Vote} H.R. 1968, a continuing appropriations bill for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2025. The bill passed.

issues.name: Semiconductors and upstate investment
issues.intro: His statements on CHIPS grants and science jobs in upstate New York.

statementPicks.t: Schumer tied a Capital Region manufacturing expansion to his CHIPS and Science Law.
statementPicks.q: Thanks to billions from Schumer’s CHIPS & Science Law, this expansion will create thousands of good-paying manufacturing and union construction jobs in the Capital Region.

issues.name: Iran war and war powers
issues.intro: Votes on war powers resolutions, and his statements on the Iran war.

statementPicks.t: Schumer said New Yorkers are bearing the cost of the Iran war and other policies.
statementPicks.q: New Yorkers are bearing the cost of failed policies, including tariffs, cuts to vital programs like SNAP and Medicaid, and a reckless war in Iran that has driven up food and fuel prices, putting even greater strain on the budgets of Upstate New York families.

items.t: {Vote} the motion to discharge S.J. Res. 59, a war powers resolution to remove U.S. forces from hostilities against Iran. The motion was rejected.
{Vote} the motion to discharge S.J. Res. 90, a war powers resolution on Venezuela. The motion was rejected.
{Vote} the motion to discharge S.J. Res. 98, a war powers resolution on Venezuela. The motion was agreed to.

items.text: In remarks at a breakfast gathering of Jewish leaders in New York City, Schumer said, “I have many jobs as leader … and one is to fight for aid to Israel, all the aid that Israel needs.” Date of the remarks not confirmed; this is a secondary report, so it needs his own transcript or release before it's final.
